The '''Tonali Cavern''' is a dungeon located beneath the [[Crypt of Tonali]] in the [[Tlati Rainforest]] region of [[Varlamore]]. Accessing it requires completion of the [[The Final Dawn]] quest. It features a number of [[Slayer]] monsters and leads to the [[Ruins of Mokhaiotl]].

The central section contains a lift which can be activated to allow a two-way transit from the central section to the [[Tlati Rainforest]]. West of this lift is a chest which can be looted to obtain two [[tonali teleporter]]s, which allow instant teleportation between the two nodes, provided that they are placed within a 30 tile range from each other. The western Moon chamber contains grimy lizards, while the eastern Sun chamber contains earthen nagua, both of which are in a [[multicombat area]] and only appear after completion of the quest.

Players '''cannot''' set up a [[dwarf multicannon]] within the cavern. Attempting to do so yields the chatbox message: ''"An ancient magical force won't let you set up a cannon here."''

==Transportation==
*[[Mokhaiotl waystone]]s can be used to teleport directly inside the Ruins of Mokhaiotl, then run south to the cavern.
*The [[Pendant of Ates]] can be used to teleport to [[Kastori]] just east of the cavern's entrances.
*The [[Quetzal Transport System]] can be used to land at [[Tal Teklan]] or [[Kastori]], both near the cavern's entrances.
